content: Isare doribar felain
He šomot iš no diya ruṭir idor din hãse aišše, ze idore uddar id o howa za.
Ar dõr imam edde alem okkole ki bafe Isare mari felai fare hitara gufone he kušiš goijjil, kiyollahoile hitara manuš zonore ḍoraito.
Toi Ehudah Iskariyot, oi barozon sahabir ekzon, hitar butore Šoitan góille.
Toi hite ḍõr iman okkol edde dórmogór sõloya garḍ okkol loi dola oito giye edde kibafe Isare hitarar hatot tuli di faribo he babute mošora goijje.
Henot hitara kuši oiye edde hitare ṭĩya dibo wada diye.
Ar henot Ehudaye o razi oiye edde manuš okkolor nozor arguwale Isare hitarar hatot tuli dibolla šuzug tuwa šuru goijje.
Isar šeš hána
Tarfore iš no diya ruṭir idor butore ze din uddar idor sool kurbani gora o, he din aišše.
Toi Isaye Fitor edde Yuhannare hoi defeṛadde,

content.text: "Tũwara zo, uddar idor hána tiyar gorogoi, ãra uddar idor hána háiyum."

content: Hitara hodde, "Hoṛe tiyar goijjum? Tũwar issa ki?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara šohorot golile ekzon manuše ek gora fani boi loi zadde lot faiba. Tũwara hitar fise fise, hite ze górot golibo, heṛe zaiba.
Ar he góror malikore hoiba, 'Huzure fusar goijje, gorba gór hoṛe, zeṛe ãi ãr šahabi okkolore loi uddar idor hána hái fari?'
Henot hite tũwarare ekkan šaz guz goijja dui ṭalar uwore ekkan ḍõr kamera dehai dibo. Heṛe zai tũwara hána gorogoi."

content: Hitara baisa diye edde Isaye zendilla hoil, he mozin lot faiye, ar hitara uddar idor hána tiyar goijje.
Bade ṭaim mozin Isaye asab okkolore loi haito boišše.
Hetunot Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi duk šoibar age tũwarar fũwati ei uddar idor hána háiyum, ãi kub issa goijji.
Ãi tũwarare hoir, ze foijjonto Allar raijjo furon no o, ãi ar honokon ei idor hána na háiyum."

content: Bade Isaye fiyala loiye, šukuriya zanaiye edde hodde,

content.text: "Lo in, tũwarar maze bag gori lo.
Kiyollahoile ãi tũwarare hoir, ze foijjonto Allar raijjo no aiye, ehon oite he foijjonto ãi ãnguror roš ar no fiyum."

content: Bade Isaye ruṭi loi šukuriya zanaiye edde hin bangi ṭura ṭura gori asab okkolore diyore hodde,

content.text: "In ãr ga, ziyan tũwaralla diya oiye. Ãre monot goribolla endilla goijjo."

content: Ar ekkui bafe, Isaye hána šeš oi bade fiyalawa hãtot loi hodde,

content.text: "Ei fiyala ãr louwor noya wadar sukti, ze lou tũwaralla ḍali diya oiye.
Kintu so, ze ãlloi beimani goribo, hite ãr fũwati hána hár.
Kiyollahoile zendilla faisala gori raikke, he bafe Adomor Fut zar. Kintu bifod hitar, ze Adomor Fut loi beimani gorer."

content: Hetunot asab okkole ekzone ekzon loi fusar gora šuru goijje ze hitarar butore endilla ham hone goribo.
Ar asab okkolor butore hone hokkolottuwaro ḍõr hin loi hitara hota haṛa haṛi goijje.
Hetunot Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Oihudi dešor raza okkolena hitarar mainšor uwore munifgiri deha. Ar hitara zonogonor dusto boli o ho.
Kintu tũwara hendilla no oiyo. Bolke tũwarar butore ze beggunottuwaro ḍõr hite beggunottuwaro šoṛor ḍoilla ok. Ar ze neta hite šeba goroyar ḍoilla ok.
Kiyollahoile hone ḍõr? Ki ze hánar ṭebilot haito boiye, hite, naki ze gulame hána baride, hite? Ze hánar ṭebilot haito boiye, hite no ne! Kintu ãi tũwarar maze šeba goroyar ḍoilla oi roiyi.
Funo! Tũwara ãr har bola mosibot okkolot maze ãr fũwati roiyo.
Ar ãr Bafe zendilla ãre šašon kemota diye, hendilla ãi o tũwara ekkan raijjo diyi.
Zene tũwara ãr raijjot ãr mezot boi há fiya gori faro. Ar tũwara šingašonot boi Israilor baro bongšor bisar goriba.
"Simon, Simon, sa! Šoitane tũwara beggunore gĩyur dana salefan salibolla dabi gorer.
Kintu ãi tolla duwa gorir, zene tor iman komzur no o. Tui abar zẽtte ãr hãse firi aibi hẽtte tor báiyaindore tui tuwajjo dis."

content: Fitore Isare hodde, "Malik, õnor fũwati ãi ziyolot zaibolla edde moribolla o razi asi."
Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Fitor, ãi tore hoir, aijja rata kuraye bak no dite, tui ãre no sinos hoi tin bar ošikar goribi."

content: Tarfore Isaye sahabi okkolore fusar goredde:

content.text: "Ãi zẽtte tũwarare ṭiyar toli, gaṭṭi edde zuta in hono kissu sara defeṛailam, tũwarattu ki hẽtte hono kissur obaf oil ne?"

content: Hitara hodde, "Na, no o."
Hetunot Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Kintu ehon zattu ṭiyar toli ase, te hin lok, ekkui bafe gaṭṭi o lok. Zattu toluwar nai hite hitar kuruta besi ekkan toluwar kinok.
Kiyollahoile ãi tũwarare hoir, pak kalamot ze leka ase: 'Adomor Futore naforman okkolor fũwati gona oiye,' hendilla ãr duwara furon oibo. Kiyollahoile ãr babute zin howa oiye, hin furon or."

content: Hetunot sahabi okkole hodde, "Malik, so, eṛe duiyan toluwar ase." Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Oiye oiye!"

content: Isaye Zaitun faharot duwa gorer
Bade Isaye niyoli zai nizor rosom mozin zaitun faharor mikka fõt bai za šuru goijje. Ar fũwati sahabi okkol o fise fise giye.
Isa heṛe fõsi bade sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara duwa goro, zene tũwara forikkat no foro."

content: Bade Isaye hitarattuwaro hom beši ek dolar fõtot giye edde ãṛu feli munazat gora šuru goijje.
Munazatot hodde,

content.text: "Ya, Baf, zodi tũi so, ãr hãsottu ei motor fiyala dur goro. Tarfore o ãr issaye no, tũwar issaye furon ok."

content: Hetunot behostottu ekzon firista aiyore Isare šokti diye.
Toi Isaye moron hoštoye mogno oi aro issa zuge munazat goijje. Ar Isar gar gám zen lour fuṛar ḍoilla oi meṛit fora šuru goijje.
Isaye munazat gori uṛi bade sahabi okkolor hãse aišše, ar dekedde hitarare, monor dukkor zoriya gumot fori giyoi.
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Gum zor kiyolla? Uṛo, forikkat no forofan duwa goro."

content: Isaye hota howat roiye, hen šomot so, heṛe ek ḍõr mainšor dol aišše. Ehudah, ze barozon sahabir ekzon, hite o hitarar fũwati age age aišše. Ehudaye Isare suma diyore dehai dibolla Isar hãse giye.
Kintu Isaye Ehudare hodde:

content.text: "Ehudah, sumar duwara ki Adomor Futore dori dor?"

content: Isar fũwati zara aššil hitara ki ki goṭibo hin buzi fariyore Isare fusar goredde: "Malik, ãra ki suri loi hamela goriyum?"
Ar hitarar butottu ekzone, ek ḍõr imamor gulamore hamela gori hitar ḍen han haṛi loi felaiye.
Kintu Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tam, ar hen no goris!"

content: Bade Isaye hitar han suiyore hitare bala gori diye.
Isare doribolla ze ḍõr imam okkol, dórmogór sõloya garḍ okkol edde murubbi okkol aišše. Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi ki ḍahait ze tũwara laṛi sura, toluwar loi aiššo?
Ãi zẽtte fotti din dórmogórot tũwarar fũwati aššilam, hẽtte to ãr uwore tũwara hat o no tulo. Kintu ehon tũwarar šomoi, andaror razotto soler."

content: Fitore Isare tin bar ošikar goijje
Toi hitara Isare dori loi giyegoi edde Isare ḍõr imamor górot ainne. Ar Fitor o dure taki hitarar fise fise giye.
Bade manuš okkol zara uṛanot oinor ṭal zali boišše hitarar fũwati Fitor o boišše.
Heṛe oinor ṭalor forot Fitor boiššede ek bandi maya fuwaye deki hitar mikka suk firai hodde, "Ei manušwa o utar fũwati aššil."
Kintu Fitore ošikar gori hodde, "He maya fuwa, ãi hitare no sini."
Ekkena gori bade ar ekzone Fitorore deki hodde, "Tui o to hitarar ekzon." Fitore hodde, "Na, ãi no."
Gonḍa anik bade ar ekzone zure hodde, "Soiyi, ei manušwa o hitar fũwati aššil, kiyollahoile ite o Galil elehar manuš."
Hetunot Fitore hodde, "No, tui ki hor ãi buzi no farir." Fitore hen hoiya šeš no oite uggwa rata kuraye bak di uiṭṭe.
Hetunot Malik Isaye Fitoror mikka muk firai saiye. Henot Isaye ze hota hoil:

content.text: "Aijja ratakuraye bak no dite, tui ãre no sinos hoi tinbar ošikar goribi,"

content: hiyan Fitorottu monot foijje.
Hetunot Fitore baire zai kub hainde.
Ihudi dórmor murobbi okkolor sarme Isa
Ar Isare sõi roiyede manuš okkole Isare loi ṭaṭṭa goijje edde maijje.
Hitara Isar suk bandi Isattu fusar goredde, "Tui zodi nobi oi takos toile ho sai, tore hone maijje?"
Ar hitara ingša gori Isar berudde aro bout hota okkol hoiye.
Din zehon oiye, Ihudi dórmo komitir murubbi okkol, ḍõr imam okkol edde alem okkol beggune ekkui fũwati dola oiye. Toi Isare hitarar munttu ana oiye
edde hodde, "Tui zodi he Mosi, toile ãrare ho!" Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Zodi ãi tũwarare hoi, tũwara biššaš no goriba.
Ar zodi tũwarare fusar gori, hono zuwab no diba.
Kintu ehonottu loti Adomor Fut šoktiwala Allar ḍen ḍakottu boiṛa takibo."

content: Hetunot hitara beggune fusar goredde, "Toile ki tui Allar Fut?" Isaye hitarare zuwab diye,

content.text: "Tũwara hor ze, Ãi Hiba."

content: Toi hitara hodde, "Ãrattu ar gobar ki dorhar? Ãra beggune hitar nizor mukottu funilam."
